dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey rings with irregular, diffuse exterior perimeters and darker interior cores. The most prominent rings show a 3-5 pixel wide gradient transition from the bright perimeter to the darker base pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, solid light-grey clusters in the mid-posterior region, where individual annuli appear to coalesce into a non-uniform, high-intensity mass lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest upper-lateral annuli form a distinct scalene triangle; a secondary cluster of four smaller centroids forms an elongated trapezoidal pattern near the upper-center dorsal line.
